name: Can I clean up fire extinguisher residue myself, or should I hire professionals?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean up fire extinguisher residue myself, or should I hire professionals?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small, non-corrosive residue incidents in well-ventilated areas, simple cleanup may be possible. However, professional cleanup is highly recommended for most situations. Fire extinguisher residue can be corrosive, particularly to sensitive electronics, and difficult to remove completely from porous surfaces. Professionals have specialized equipment, cleaning agents, and training to safely and effectively remove all residue, mitigate corrosion, and prevent secondary damage. They also ensure proper disposal of contaminated materials and address potential health concerns from airborne particles.
acceptedAnswer.description: While minor residue might be DIY, professional cleanup is recommended for most incidents due to residue corrosiveness, difficulty of removal, and potential health hazards. Professionals have specialized tools and expertise.
